checks.rationale: Both task acceptance criteria now have current evidence: exact-root inspection and conditional ref operations preserve developer state for all three repaired schedules.
REQ-02/AC-02 safety is restored for the concrete alias and changed-checkout schedules; frozen specification exclusions remain respected.

Traced the five changed functions and new symbolic-ref observer through their callers. Both-host regressions verify the repaired behavior; 67 existing function implementations are AST-identical to the prior reviewed candidate.

A checkout whose branch/published HEAD/admitted path no longer agrees returns unknown with changed=None and no read-tree. Dirty/index, uncertain-read-tree and lost-publication controls pass without blind retries.

Initial and late symbolic aliases, actual branch switch, empty/shaped fake metadata, genuine direct missing HEAD and linked-worktree missing HEAD are exercised on both hosts; checkout pointers remain unchanged.

The four required new regressions are owned and tracked. Each host passes 15 focused tests without skips plus two independent metadata observations; current candidate-bound coordinator evidence records 33 tests with one Windows filename skip.

The correction remains in the Git adapter, owned tests and handoff. It adds no downstream TASK-009/011/023 implementation, port, stdin field, schema or ignored runtime asset. Unaffected prior scope reasoning is retained.

Recomputed clean exact HEAD/base, three owned paths, every context/validation hash, policy-model digest and fingerprint. Accepted002/006 ancestry and bytes, graph/isolation digest, and owner-tested owned/dependency blobs match.

Frozen GitRepository and CommandRunner signatures, explicit submodule imports and injected local bindings remain compatible with accepted002/006. The finite helper remains in tracked git_ops.py; unaffected architecture reasoning and evidence are reused.

All transactions prohibit dereferencing and changed checkout identity prevents advancement. Fixed shell=False argv, trusted runtime and genuine digest-checked outer evidence remain intact. Independent native Astra/xhigh rank4 selection and unavailable separate provider-effective identity are disclosed.

The full updated handoff accurately records the three fixes, safe late-alias conversion, existing interface/runtime closure, actual matrix and explicit missing-HEAD limits; historical failed evidence remains unchanged.

findings.description: Historical finding resolved on c2: preflight rejects an already-symbolic target; every private ref transaction uses --no-deref. Both actual-repository tests pass on Windows/Linux, preserving developer main, index/status/files; a late alias may safely become the requested direct target without moving its referent.

Add an actual-repository regression preserving developer HEAD, index and files; update the handoff.

findings.description: Historical finding resolved on c2: managed reconciliation requires the exact branch, published HEAD, admitted resolved path as sole checkout, old/new tree/index and clean observations before advancement. Both-host actual checkout-to-developer regression returns unknown/changed=None, performs zero read-tree calls and preserves developer bytes; dirty/index/uncertain controls pass.

Revalidate the admitted branch, binding and sole checkout, expected published HEAD, old index and worktree before permitting read-tree. Add the actual branch-switch regression and retain existing dirty/index preservation tests; update the handoff.

findings.description: Historical finding resolved on c2: exact-root metadata layout/backlink validation, unconditional root probing and contradictory-HEAD rejection prevent parent fallback.
